grammar.summary: 本课学习 there will be 将来存在句与方位描述。

points.title: there will be
points.explanation: there be 句型的将来式：There will be a new house there. 表未来将出现的事物。

examples.en: There will be a beautiful garden around the house.
examples.cn: 房子周围将有一个漂亮的花园。

points.title: 方位介词综合
points.explanation: in the south of / near / beside / away from 多个方位介词的空间关系描述，为完形填空高频考点。

examples.en: My new house is in the country.

exercises.q: ___ were some men digging up the road outside my house.
Look at those clouds. I think ___ will be a thunderstorm.
After dinner ___ will be a long discussion on politics.
When will ___ be convenient for you to come?
